description:
Log in to ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus and create a new project in the Projects module with the following details:

- Project Title: Email Migration to Microsoft 365
- Description: Migration of 500 user mailboxes from on-premises Exchange 2016 to Microsoft 365, including planning, pilot migration, full migration, and post-migration validation.
- Owner / Project Manager: Administrator
- Priority: High
- Status: Open (or the default initial status)
- Scheduled Start Date: February 1, 2025 (02/01/2025)
- Scheduled End Date: June 30, 2025 (06/30/2025)

After filling in all fields, save the project.

Login credentials:
- URL: https://localhost:8080
- Username: administrator
- Password: administrator (if a password change is required, change it to Admin1234!)

The Firefox browser is already open and pointed to the ServiceDesk Plus login page.
